summary: Backend testing of LIVE/DRAFT fee plan feature. 8/8 pytest tests passed covering all 5 acceptance criteria. First plan auto-goes live and assigns to class students; second plan comes back as draft without assignment; set-live promotes draft and demotes previous live (only-one-live invariant holds); GET /api/fees/plans returns status field; student dues re-sync on set-live and on live-plan edits but NOT on draft edits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3944 lines; consider splitting into routers (fees, students, classes, auth) for maintainability.

_demote_sibling_plans + create_fee_plan flow correctly enforces single-live per class+session; race condition risk under concurrent POSTs is minor but exists (no unique index/transaction). Consider a partial unique index on {school_id, class_id, academic_session, status:'live'}.
update_fee_plan pops status silently; documented intent is fine, but returning 400 when caller passes status could avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: Created one class LIVEDRAFT-<tag>, one student, one fee head, and two fee plans (Plan A live/draft, Plan B live) per test run. Not cleaned up (per instructions to preserve seeded data; test data is uniquely tagged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_fee_plan_live_draft.py as regression for LIVE/DRAFT fee plans. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/test_fee_plan_live_draft.py. School resolved via GET /api/schools + X-School-Id header.
